why: Two unrelated one-shots. The larger group stays: G1, items 60576/60577, 1pp Blank and Bob Kane Foil cover files of the 2024 'Detective Comics 27 Batman Day Special Edition' (GCD 215499, DC 2024, 1 issue; both per-file linked to it). Item 62590, the 29pp 2017 'Batman Day Special Edition 001' (CV 104455 'Batman Day Special Edition' DC 2017 1 issue, not in CvVolume = needs-fetch; GCD 117053 'Batman Day Special Edition' DC 2017, 1 issue; both per-file links agree), moves to a key named for itself. No live shelf stores CV 104455 or GCD 117053 (--who-stores: only S2095's own per-file links, 0 S lines), so it is a new key, not a join. Nearby S1969 is the 2021 Knightwatch special (CV 138905 / GCD 176145), another book. Note for the lead: S94865 (Detective Comics 2016, CV 91098) holds item 59990 'Detective Comics 027 Special Edition (2024)' 27pp, per-file linked to GCD 215499 - the full rip of the same 2024 special whose covers stay here; it is residue on that run and belongs with this shelf, but S94865's identity is the 2016 run, so no join is written.
